page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E4.Flex.64-256 is a compute-oriented virtual machine configuration built on the x86_64 architecture. It is driven by AMD EPYC 7J13 processors operating at a base frequency of 2.55 GHz. The instance is provisioned with 64 dedicated physical cores running two threads per core, yielding 128 vCPUs. System memory totals 256 GB, which establishes a 1:2 ratio of vCPUs to RAM, or 2.0 GB per virtual processor. Network connectivity includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Hardware trade-offs for this profile center on memory density and storage architecture. The instance includes no integrated local NVMe storage, meaning all persistent data and operating system installations require remote block volume attachments. Additionally, the instance contains no GPU acceleration hardware. Its architectural focus is directed strictly at multi-threaded x86 compute capacity rather than memory-heavy or hardware-accelerated processing.

Because of the balanced core count and lower memory footprint per core, this configuration provides cost-efficient operational characteristics for throughput-bound processing where RAM usage is predictable. Best-fit workloads include parallel batch computations, distributed processing worker nodes, CI/CD compilation and build farms, large web application clusters, and multi-threaded simulation tasks.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E4.Flex.64-256 is a compute-focused virtual machine powered by x86_64 AMD EPYC 7J13 processors clocked at 2.55 GHz. The configuration provisions 64 dedicated physical cores supporting 128 vCPUs via simultaneous multithreading, paired with 256 GB of memory. This architecture provides a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio suitable for high-density compute tasks. The instance includes zero integrated local storage, requiring network-attached block volumes for persistence, and does not feature GPU accelerators. Network connectivity includes a single complimentary public IPv4 address. Given its dedicated core allocation and compact memory footprint per thread, the instance offers strong resource efficiency for horizontally parallel operations. Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E4.Flex.64-256 is suited for multi-threaded batch jobs, software compilation pipelines, distributed data workers, and scalable container hosting environments.
